definitions.gloss: strikeout; being called out on three strikes
definitions.explanation: in baseball, when a batter accumulates three strikes and is out

examples.japanese: {見逃|みのが}し{三振|さんしん}に{倒|たお}れた。
ピッチャーは10{個|こ}の{三振|さんしん}を{奪|うば}った。

notes:
BASEBALL TERM:
{三振|さんしん} combines {三|さん} (three) + {振|しん} (swing). It refers to accumulating three strikes.

TYPES OF STRIKEOUTS:
- {空振|からぶ}り{三振|さんしん} - swinging strikeout
- {見逃|みのが}し{三振|さんしん} - called strikeout (looking)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三振|さんしん}を{取|と}る/{奪|うば}う - to strike out (as pitcher)
- {三振|さんしん}に{倒|たお}れる - to strike out (as batter)
- {三振|さんしん}を{喫|きっ}する - to suffer a strikeout

STATISTICS:
- {奪|うば}{三振|さんしん} - strikeouts (pitcher stat)
- {三振率|さんしんりつ} - strikeout rate

SCOREKEEPING:
In Japanese scorekeeping, K is used for strikeouts as in English.

RELATED TERMS:
- {空振|からぶ}り - swing and miss
- {見逃|みのが}し - called strike
- {四球|しきゅう} - walk (base on balls)
